The '''Forgotten Terrace''' was a location in the [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]] of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. During the [[Revanite crisis]], leading members of the [[Yavin Coalition]], such as [[Darth Marr]] and [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]] traveled to the Forgotten Terrace with a ship that departed from the [[Coalition Command Post]]. The Coalition's forces confronted [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] at a [[Order of Revan|Revanite]] temple situated in the Forgotten Terrace and managed to defeat him.<ref name="SOR" />
